answer:
According to the newest release notes covering LFM3 (v0.40.13), the LFM3 models run on Linux and Windows as well as Apple silicon:

"Liquid AI's [LFM3](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3) models, including text-to-speech in [lfm3-audio](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-audio) and [lfm3-omni](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-omni), now run on Linux and Windows as well as Apple silicon." [ollama/v0.40.13.md]

This supersedes the earlier v0.40.12 note, which said LFM3 was Apple-only at launch: "Note: lfm3 and d1 2b are supported on Apple hardware in this release. Support for Linux/Windows coming soon." [ollama/v0.40.12.md]

So as of 0.40.13, the platforms are Apple silicon (macOS), Linux, and Windows.
